title: Capability closure core
notes: Close one semantic capability gap through existing provisioning/catalog boundaries.

title: Capability closure trust hardening
notes: Candidate must not become validated without explicit verifier, evidence, contract tests and rollback.

title: Workflow capability-gap resume
notes: Replan the preserved original IR against fresh capability memory; never inherit authorization.

title: Product/API gap inspection and resume seam
notes: Expose blocked workflow gaps read-only and allow safe replan after validated external closure.

title: Generic compiled capability consumption
notes: Compiled independent artifact consumes resolved executable binding generically and fails closed when it cannot.

title: Self state and truth projection
notes: AY must distinguish usable, detected, missing and evidenced state without inventing readiness.

title: Incremental semantic and logic node index
notes: On repository change cycles, hash tracked files, read only changed/new eligible files, remove deleted entries and derive file/symbol/semantic/logic nodes into a local non-canonical context graph.

title: Bounded node-context spider for complex gaps
notes: When AY resolves NEED_CONTEXT or a multi-subsystem why/impact/dependency gap, traverse the derived node graph with bounded depth/nodes/edges and return facts/relations without making conclusions.

title: Resolver routes complex gaps to node context
notes: AY triggers the spider only when active state is insufficient for a relational decision; simple lookup stays cheap, deterministic work prefers scripts, human input remains for irreducible decisions/authorization.

title: Crystallize repeated complex analysis into task scripts
notes: Prove the pattern by crystallizing the repeated IR-vs-compiler audit into one deterministic structured script; future repeated analysis should prefer this script over fresh graph/LLM work.

title: Close resolution into evidence state and cheaper reuse
notes: Cache only verified successful derived results with evidence refs and source fingerprint; the next equivalent resolution reuses them only while the fingerprint matches. This cache never grants capability trust or authorization.

title: Post-cycle Spider assimilation via GitHub Actions
notes: After a successful Trust Gate on main, restore the prior derived context graph, read only changed/new files through the incremental index, traverse affected nodes with the Spider, and publish a bounded context artifact for the next development cycle. No development mutation occurs in this workflow.

title: Post-cycle next-work synthesis
notes: After Spider assimilation, combine canonical declared work state with bounded post-cycle context and emit next_cycle.json. Context may rank declared candidates but must never invent work or mutate main.

title: GitHub Actions development-cycle dispatcher
notes: Consume next_cycle.json and dispatch only an explicitly supported development executor through a branch/PR boundary; stop when no declared actionable work or no supported executor exists.
